Egypt’s ULTIMATE street-food: 𝗞𝗼𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗿𝘆! 🇪🇬

If you're heading to Cairo, stopping at Koshary 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂 𝗧𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗸 is a non-negotiable food stop.

This iconic multi-level restaurant in central Cairo serves comfort food with lightning-fast service, for around 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 $𝟭!

What goes into Koshary? 🤔

🍝 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗯 𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲: Macaroni and spaghetti mixed with brown lentils and chickpeas.

🧅 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗼𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀: Crispy fried onions for that satisfying crunch, plus extra chickpeas served on the side.

🌶️ 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝗿𝗲𝘁: A slightly spicy, tangy tomato sauce poured generously over the top before mixing it all together.

🥤 𝗣𝗿𝗼 𝗧𝗶𝗽: Wash it down with a local Egyptian soda like V Cola for the ultimate local experience!
